expected_title: Successful tool calls can still miss a critical outage
notice: All four setups find costly outage 187–189. None finds infeasible outage 15–16, despite successful tool calls.

expected_title: Show both trial counts and uncertainty
notice: Each point uses ten attempts. The 95% intervals show substantial uncertainty around the reported success rate.

expected_title: PowerBench finds answers across linked records
notice: Follow the verification loop before check and fault reports are created. These are synthetic benchmark records, not operating data.

changes.caption: Original PowerBench Figure 1: synthesis and document-generation panels (excerpt).

expected_title: PowerBench results: complete answers and partial credit
notice: Blue measures complete answers. Orange gives field-level partial credit. Different averaging weights can reverse their order.

expected_title: A strong average can hide a weak task group
notice: Compare the three colored task groups: each uses different evidence and requires a complete result.

changes.caption: Original PowerBench Figure 2. Task groups receive equal weight in Macro-JA.

expected_title: More required steps can lower overall reliability
notice: At 99% success per independent step, 20 required steps succeed together only 81.8% of the time.

expected_title: The answer changes when we change what we count
notice: The two false approvals are 10% of the 20 infeasible cases, even though they are 2% of all cases.

expected_title: Zero test failures do not prove perfect performance
notice: The bound shrinks with more independent trials. Zero failures in 300 trials still allows a 0.994% upper failure bound.
